files: new contracts/paid-board/src/revenue.rs, src/safety.rs (remove withdraw_near, reserve formula), ft_on_transfer message parsing in src/payments.rs
goal:
Revenue leaves the board only through the split. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §R1, §R2, §C5 (reserve formula only).

SCOPE
- Remove withdraw_near (owner decision, 1 Nov).
- distribute_near(): anyone, at most once per distribution_interval_ns (default 1 h); 10% team_account, 90% buyback_account; callback restores on failure.
- ft_on_transfer accepts a second message {"revenue":{}} only from buyback_account; all accepted mPOO adds to mpoo_undistributed.
- distribute_mpoo(): anyone, same interval; 10% ft_transfer to team, 20% burn on the mPOO contract using the signature recorded by mpoo-burn-signature, 70% to mpoo_staker_reserve, forwarded once staking_contract is set (set-once); callbacks restore each leg on failure.
- set_team_account / set_buyback_account: owner, 7-day cooldown, event. set_staking_contract: owner, once.
- get_withdrawable_near: storage used + empty cells x STORAGE_PER_PIXEL + reserve floor (outstanding credits no longer reserve storage).
- get_revenue_state view.

ACCEPTANCE
- Every test listed under R1 and R2 in the spec, plus: withdrawable never dips into the reserve; nobody, owner included, can move the staker reserve before staking_contract is set.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and docs/backlog.md updated in the same PR.
